[[File:ExplosiveRange.png|20px|Explosion Range]]6 (Explosion Range) |speed = 7 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |flying = No }} ==Description== The '''Swat Van''' ('''Special weapons and tactics Van''') is a high health unit spawned by the [[Enforcer]] tower on its bottom path. It is summoned using the ''SWAT Van'' ability which has a cooldown of 45 seconds. The '''Swat Van''' is a large vehicle which primarily deals damage through collisions, and moves rather swiftly on the path. On top of this, it has [[Defense]] increasing damage dealt through collisions and also reducing damage from enemy abilities. It explodes upon death, akin to the units of [[Military Base]], supposedly dealing extra damage, though currently this does not appear to work. ==Appearance== The '''Swat Van''' is a large, black armored van with grey handlebars, orange headlights, yellow lights at the top with a red and blue lights. It has a few entirely black windows on the front and sides. On the side of the van, a logo can be seen, presumably for a police force of some sort. ==Statistics==

==Skins== ''To see all the upgrades of a skin, see the [[/Gallery#Skin Upgrades|gallery]] page.'' {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:AbyssalSwatVan.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Beach|Abyssal}} |- !Obtained From |[[Beach Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *As the '''Swat Van''' is an ability unit, it can be saved to help out on specific tough waves. **This is very similar to [[Commander]]'s units, though the latter costs money to deploy, while '''Swat Vans''' are completely free to deploy. **Its high health means it can be used against single high-health enemies, while its explosion can help out against hordes of weaker enemies. **This allows it to be coordinated much more easily, allowing for various different formations through timing. ***For instance, one could cluster all the vans together which deal incredible damage when combining all their health. *The '''Swat Van''' could also just be sent out as soon as the ability goes off cooldown, making it function similarly to the [[Military Base]], though it is somewhat tedious to constantly watch the ability cooldown. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} EnforcerBanner2.png|'''Swat Van''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} EnforcerBanner.png|'''Swat Van''' on a promotional image. }} ==Update History== *'''14 August 2026''' - [[v2.6.0]] **'''Swat Van''' added. **{{Bug}} Explosion deals no damage. *'''4 September 2026''' - [[v2.9.0]] **New skin: {{Color|Beach|Abyssal}} {{TowerNavBox}}
